text:
Harper: FYI - was pinged by two interviewers who say they weren't assigned to a panel but got calendar invites and couldn't find the candidate in Orbit.
Zoe: Hmm, are these duplicate invites or mismatched candidate IDs?
Harper: Duplicate invites. One invite points to cand-11011, the other to cand-11012. They were scheduled back-to-back but only one panel should have included them.
Marcus: That's worrying. Could be the calendar sync job deduping by email instead of panel ID. We pushed a change to the scheduler last week.
Rina: I also saw one case where an interviewer accepted invite A and the ATS marked them as unavailable for invite B, so debrief ended up short-staffed.
Harper: Exactly. Two panels ended up a person short because Orbit assumed they were unavailable after they accepted the duplicate.
Zoe: Can we patch quickly? For immediate mitigation, Ops suggests disabling the automatic accept/provision step that flips availability when a calendar reply is received.
Marcus: I'll roll that back on prod feature-flag. Before I do, can we gather the impacted panels? Harper, can you drop the candidate IDs and times?
Harper: Pairs: cand-11011 (10:00-10:45) & cand-11012 (10:50-11:35) — interviewer Sam L got both invites at 09:10; he accepted the first.
Rina: We also have cand-11030/cand-11031 where the hiring manager had to chase folks to rebook.
Zoe: Short-term process: ask interviewers to verify invites in Orbit if they get multiple calendar invites; if mismatch, DM hiring ops to reconcile. We'll send a quick note to all scheduling coordinators.
Marcus: Patch rolled back to staging, running smoke tests on calendar webhook handler. Root cause looks like a new dedupe key that concatenates email+client_token; client_token differs when scheduling via mobile vs web, so dedupe failed.
Harper: That explains the split. Any plan to avoid this in future?
Marcus: Yes - change dedupe to use panel_id + interviewer_email for uniqueness. Also add a validation that prevents auto-toggling availability unless panel_id matches the calendar event metadata. I'll open INF-2147.
Zoe: We should also add a quick checkbox on the scheduling form: "Confirm this invite is for panel X (panel id shown)" to make it explicit to coordinators. Small UX step reduces human errors.
Rina: Training note: we'll add a 5-min micro-training for schedulers covering the panel_id check and how to handle duplicate calendar invites. I'll publish to #hiring-resources.
ops-bot: Incident INF-2147 created for calendar dedupe bug. Priority: P2. Owner: Marcus.
hiring-bot: New micro-training "Scheduler: panel_id sanity checks (5m)" published. RSVP optional. :bookmark_tabs:
Harper: Thanks all. For ongoing panels today, I'll run a quick audit to ensure no other interviewers got double-invited. If anyone sees a missing interviewer in debrief, tag this thread.
Marcus: Staging tests clear. Rolling rollback to prod now and will monitor for 15m.
Zoe: After rollback, let's run a 24-hour audit to find any panels that had availability toggled incorrectly and notify affected hiring managers. I'll draft the notification template.
Rina: Also adding a short scheduler checklist to onboarding so new coordinators know to check Orbit before sending invites.
Harper: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Filing post-incident notes and action items in INF-2147 (owner: Marcus).
